conviction_note: Net of a genuinely unpriced IEEPA duty-refund optionality (+3.0) and a peer channel that ran hot in the exact May-July quarter Zumiez guided conservatively for (+2.5), against the one thing that has demonstrably moved this stock -- the month-to-date comp printed in the release, which laps +11.2% total / +13.0% North America (-4.0) -- plus float/short convexity (+1.0); the sum is +2.5 on a name whose own prints move 11-14%, so the band is very wide and the sign is low-confidence.

findings.finding: Zumiez is a direct importer (private label was 30.3% of FY2025 net sales, sourced 'primarily from foreign manufacturers', ~50% from China at the start of fiscal 2025) and has never quantified or guided for an IEEPA duty refund, while retailers with the identical quarter-end of 1 Aug 2026 booked large ones -- Ross $253m, Abercrombie ~$100m, Dick's $59m, G-III $129.7m -- for duties paid 4 Feb 2025 to 24 Feb 2026 that CBP began refunding through its portal on 20 April 2026 with ~60-90 day turnaround plus statutory interest.
findings.source_date: 2026-04 (FY2026 10-K for fiscal year ended 2026-01-31); private label 30.3%/27.8%/23.0% of net sales and 'most of our merchandise is imported and is subject to duties'
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus of $(0.14) sits almost exactly on the midpoint of the company's own $(0.23)-$(0.08) guide, which contains no refund; if a refund of even $5m were modelled by the two EPS estimates, consensus would be a profit, not a loss. Zumiez's Q1 call of 4 June 2026 -- three and a half months after the 20 Feb 2026 Supreme Court ruling -- contains not one instance of the words tariff, duty, customs, IEEPA, refund or import, so there is no sell-side number to anchor on. Coresight's 8 Sept 2026 survey of who booked 2Q26 refunds names Abercrombie, Urban Outfitters and Gap and does not mention Zumiez at all. A priced version of this would show the stock above, not at, its 52-week low with 25-delta put skew at +7.36 and a 4.9x put/call open interest ratio.
findings.independence: Management itself flagged the category as unmodelled upside on the 12 March 2026 Q4 call -- CFO Chris Work referred to 'potential tariff benefits, should the current situation hold throughout the year' with no dollar figure attached (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/03/17/zumiez-zumz-q4-2025-earnings-call-transcript/), and the same call disclosed that Zumiez pulled forward $7m of Chinese inventory ahead of tariff increases and was cutting China sourcing from ~50% to ~30%, which is the behaviour of an importer of record that actually paid the duties. Refund mechanics and eligibility window from CBP: https://www.cbp.gov/trade/programs-administration/trade-remedies/ieepa-duty-refunds

findings.finding: Every mall teen retailer covering Zumiez's exact quarter (ended 1-2 Aug 2026) beat: Abercrombie posted record Q2 net sales of $1.27bn and raised full-year EPS guidance to $13.10-$13.60 from $10.20-$11.00, American Eagle comps +6%, Urban Outfitters retail comps +5.6% -- whereas Zumiez set its $210-215m guide on 4 June off a May comp of -0.1% and embedded only +0.5% total comp, and its own guide range implies roughly $0.03 of EPS per $1m of sales.
findings.why_not_priced: Zumiez's guide was struck off a single four-week reading (May, -0.1% total, -1.5% North America) taken before June and July existed; the peer prints that describe those two months all landed after 4 June and none of them is a Zumiez-specific datapoint, so nothing forced the two covering EPS estimates to move -- and they did not, consensus is still sitting on the guide midpoint. If the market had done this arithmetic the stock would not be making a new 52-week low into the print with a -8.4% 20-day run-up; it would be trading at least back toward the June post-print level.
findings.independence: Tilly's, the closest single analogue (mall-based action-sports/streetwear, identical 1 Aug 2026 quarter end), reported Q2 comps +12.1% on 2 Sept 2026 against its own guidance of +6% to +10% and against its own May month-to-date of +8.3% -- i.e. June and July ran above the May run-rate, which is precisely the base Zumiez guided from (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001524025/000162828026060088/q2fy2026earningsrelease.htm). NOTE: this Tilly's document is also cited in finding 3's cluster reasoning; treat the Tilly's evidence as one source, not two.

findings.finding: The number that has actually moved this stock is the month-to-date comp printed inside the release -- last year's 4 Sept 2025 release disclosed +11.2% total and +13.0% North America for the 30 days to 1 Sept and the stock rose 13.7% -- and this year that line laps exactly those figures, while Zumiez's own most recent monthly disclosure was -0.1% total and -1.5% North America (four weeks to 30 May 2026), the first negative in its eight-quarter positive-comp run.
findings.why_not_priced: The precedent is only three months old and points the other way: on 5 June 2026 Zumiez beat on Q1 revenue and the stock still fell 11.3% purely on the forward guide, so the reported quarter and any one-time refund are not what gets traded here. A $296m cap with two EPS estimates and seven Hold ratings has no published Q3 month-to-date comp forecast at all, which is what would exist if this compare were priced -- the visible cover is a Jefferies price target cut to $17.00, i.e. to spot, which is a refusal to forecast rather than a forecast. Zumiez's own North America sequence -- +6.5% holiday, +4.4% Q1, -1.5% May -- decelerates monotonically into the hardest compare of its year.
findings.independence: Placer.ai's 6 Aug 2026 back-to-school note found that department stores and apparel retailers were the one category with year-over-year foot-traffic declines through H1 2026, with value and off-price formats taking the back-to-school trade (https://www.placer.ai/anchor/articles/heading-into-back-to-school-2026). The 5 June 2026 reaction is separately sourced at https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/zumiez-stock-dips-11-wider-124100692.html (published 2026-06-05).

findings.finding: The mechanical setup amplifies whatever direction the print takes: 1.29m shares short is 9.93% of a 12.95m-share float and 5.5 days of a 179,754-share average daily volume, against $124.1m of cash and marketable securities (43% of the $291m market cap) and a $40m buyback of which only $6.2m was used in Q1 while the stock fell to a new 52-week low through the quarter.
findings.source_date: 2026-09-10 (page as of hunt date; short interest 1.29m shares, down from 1.32m prior settlement)
findings.why_not_priced: This is convexity, not information, and it is only worth anything because the two findings above give it something to convex around; but the option chain cannot express it -- total open interest is 237 contracts and the at-the-money bid-ask is 100% of mid, so there is no listed market in which this could have been priced. A crowded short in a 12.95m float that is also buying back 11% of its own shares a year is the configuration that produced the 13.7% single-day move in September 2025.
findings.independence: Q1 fiscal 2026 10-Q, 4 June 2026: $66.9m cash plus $57.2m marketable securities, 265,000 shares repurchased for $6.2m (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001318008/000119312526257341/zumz-20260502.htm). Share count fell ~11% year over year per the Q1 call.

searched_and_found_nothing: No August or back-to-school sales pre-release from Zumiez -- ir.zumiez.com returned 503 and the EDGAR filing index shows nothing between the 17 July 2026 13G/A and the 27 Aug 2026 earnings-date notice, so the January holiday update (12 Jan 2026, 8-K) is the only intra-quarter release the company does
No Form 4 or Form 144 activity since 15 June 2026 -- the only 2026 insider cluster is the routine post-print window of 4-15 June, nothing near the print

No IEEPA, tariff, duty, customs, refund or import language anywhere in the Q1 fiscal 2026 10-Q (period ended 2 May 2026) or in the 4 June 2026 earnings call transcript -- the absence is what the finding rests on, not a positive disclosure, and I could not confirm Zumiez is importer of record on any specific entry
EUR/USD May-July 2026 versus 2025 -- could not source reliable monthly averages, so I could not test the +0.5% FX benefit embedded in the Q2 guide; dropped
Blue Tomato / European store-level news for summer 2026 -- nothing beyond the already-disclosed plan to close six international stores; no closure announcements, no distress signals
Placer.ai chain-level August 2026 visit data for Zumiez specifically -- the public notes are category-level only
Zumiez app-store review volume and the company's own site changelog/pricing pages -- no usable time series I could date
baseline_tension: It cuts against the baseline: the +7.36 put skew, the 4.9x put/call open interest, the -8.4% 20-day run-up and a spot sitting exactly on its 52-week low all say downside, and my two largest findings (an unmodelled duty refund and a peer quarter that beat) say the reported quarter is likely better than the guide -- but my third finding, the month-to-date comp lapping +13.0% North America, agrees with the skew and is the line item that has historically decided the reaction, which is why the net is only mildly positive and the bands are wide.
